steps.title: Student Authentication
steps.description: Student authenticates via development test session and opens Course registration

steps.title: Verify Student Enrolment Desk
steps.description: Student enrolment desk loads with heading and enrolment list

steps.title: Enrolment List Visible
steps.description: Student sees at least one owned enrolment in the list

steps.title: Select Owned Enrolment
steps.description: Student selects their ENROLLED enrolment to view programme and term details

steps.title: Verify Enrolment Details Panel
steps.description: Details panel shows status, programme, academic year and term for the selected enrolment

steps.title: Verify Programme Field
steps.description: Programme id is visible so the student can verify their programme

steps.title: Verify Academic Year Field
steps.description: Academic year code is visible on the enrolment detail view

steps.title: Verify Term Field
steps.description: Term name/code is visible on the enrolment detail view

steps.title: PostgreSQL Enrolment Ownership Read-Back
steps.description: Read-only query verifies the viewed enrolment belongs to student1 under the pilot tenant
steps.query: SELECT id, status, program_id, term_id, student_id FROM stu.enrolments WHERE tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND id = 'a1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000031' AND student_id = '81dd67d3-1d5f-4d8e-8061-a67648610002'

steps.title: Negative RBAC — Unauthenticated Gateway Blocked
steps.description: API Gateway blocks unauthenticated GET to enrolment detail with HTTP 401
